annotations.title: Historic Hardware Series (Fidelity or Qubit Count)

description: Return the full historic time series — either two-qubit gate error rates ("fidelity") or physical qubit counts ("qubit-count") — broken down by hardware type. Each datapoint carries a source URL. It is the raw data behind trend questions such as "when might hardware reach X?"; fit_historic_series fits a log-linear trend to one hardware type's series.

seriesType.description: "fidelity" → 2-qubit gate error rates; "qubit-count" → physical qubit counts.
